Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com
 About The Role
 As part of the B2B2C division, we are looking for a QA Engineer to join our team working on rebranded consumer products. In this role, you will be responsible for validating the desktop and web product suites that we deliver to our partners, ensuring high quality across functionality, end-to-end flows and rebranding efforts, within time, scope, and quality constraints.
We are looking for an inquisitive person who is passionate about technology, who is familiar with different operating systems and who shares our view about the value of delivering quality products.
We are looking for a person who is methodical and pays very close attention to details, but who also has the initiative to challenge and improve existing routines and processes.
 In This Role, You Will
 Design, implement, and execute manual and automated test suites for desktop (Windows & MacOS) and web applications.
 Perform functional, end-to-end, and rebranding testing to ensure consistent and high-quality user experiences.
 Submit, regress, and verify defects, conducting root-cause analysis and tracking defect resolution to completion.
 Review and provide feedback on product specifications, design documents, and test cases.
 Collaborate closely with development, design, and product teams to maintain high-quality deliverables.
 Explore and leverage AI-assisted testing tools or frameworks to enhance test coverage and efficiency.
 You Should Ideally Have
 Strong QA skills – troubleshooting, bug isolation and reporting, and a solid understanding of testing methodologies and processes.
 Experience testing across different operating systems: Windows, MacOS, Android, iOS.
 Familiarity with desktop and web testing frameworks (manual and automated).
 Basic networking knowledge.
 Scripting or automation experience, preferably with Python.
 Experience with Agile workflows and issue tracking systems such as Jira.
 Ability to create, review, and follow detailed test plans and test cases.
 Good command of written and spoken English.
 Interest or hands-on experience with AI-based testing or automation tools.
 What We Offer
 We offer you an exciting work environment inside a highly knowledgeable technical team, benefits well scaled to your performance and lots of opportunities for professional growth.
And, maybe the most important thing - you will be part of the movement to completely re-shape how Internet security for home users looks like today.
